newsitem.title: SPAIN: Morgan Stanley rates Endesa "strong buy".
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley rates Endesa "strong buy".

text.p: Brokerage Morgan Stanley has given Spanish electricity giant Endesa a "strong buy" recommendation, according to research dated February 28.
Morgan rated Iberdrola "outperform" and Union Fenosa "neutral".

Endesa's 12-month share price target was 11,500 pesetas, while Iberdrola was forecast to hit 1,850 pesetas. Fenosa was thought to be capable of rising 12.5 percent above its price at the date of the report.

Morgan Stanley said existing companies in the Spanish electricity sector should "continue to prosper in the new (competitive) environment, due to their strategic options, financial resilience and the support provided by the government in the shape of the stranded cost recovery package."
The brokerage predicted that the major power firms "will achieve underlying net cash positions before the stranded cost package drops away."
